Count non-monochromatic triangles: each such triangle has exactly two vertices where the two incident edges differ in colour. So the number of non-monochromatic triangles = (1/2) · Σ over vertices of (red·blue) = (1/2) · 43 · 20 · 22 = 43 · 220 = 9460.

Total triangles = C(43,3) = 43·42·41/6 = 12341.

Monochromatic triangles = 12341 − 9460 = 2881.

Red = 2881 − 2022 = 859.

ANSWER: 859
